rules.name: exchange_stay_requires_ikamet
rules.description: Incoming Sabancı exchange students staying 3 months or longer enter the residence-permit workflow.

rules.name: permit_type_short_term
rules.description: For the scoped Sabancı incoming exchange-student case, the workflow uses a short-term residence permit.

rules.name: application_after_entry
rules.description: A first application is started only after entry into Türkiye; Sabancı instructs entry with passport.

rules.name: apply_before_legal_stay_expiry
rules.description: The online first application must be completed before visa/visa-exemption/current legal stay expires.

rules.name: official_eikamet_channel
rules.description: Use the official e-İkamet channel for the online application.

rules.name: passport_validity_buffer
rules.description: Passport validity must extend at least 60 days beyond the requested residence-permit end date.

rules.name: application_form_signed
rules.description: The generated residence-permit application form must be signed before it counts as ready.

rules.name: passport_copy_pages_complete
rules.description: Required passport copy pages must be present; Sabancı also requires the Türkiye entry page and visa page if applicable.
rules.deterministic_condition: passport_id_page_present == true AND turkey_entry_page_present == true AND (visa_required == false OR visa_page_present == true)

rules.name: biometric_photo_current
rules.description: The biometric photo must be within 6 months and ICAO-compliant.
rules.deterministic_condition: photo_age_months <= 6 AND biometric_photo == true AND icao_compliant == true

rules.name: residence_fee_evidence
rules.description: Required residence-permit/document-fee payment evidence must be present. Exact amounts are dynamic.

rules.name: single_entry_visa_fee_conditional
rules.description: Single-entry visa fee evidence is required only when current official rules make it applicable.

rules.name: financial_capacity_declaration
rules.description: The short-term permit form requires declaration/evidence of sufficient regular financial means.

rules.name: exchange_purpose_evidence
rules.description: Official evidence of exchange/education purpose and duration must be available.

rules.name: student_certificate_present
rules.description: Sabancı requires a current student certificate in the file.

rules.name: insurance_covers_period
rules.description: Health-insurance coverage must cover the requested permit period unless a valid official exemption/alternative applies.
rules.deterministic_condition: insurance_exempt == true OR (insurance_valid_for_ikamet == true AND insurance_start_date <= requested_start_date AND insurance_end_date >= requested_end_date)

rules.name: insurance_evidence_type
rules.description: Accepted evidence is bilateral coverage, SGK provision/application evidence, or valid private health insurance.

rules.name: address_proof_sabanci
rules.description: For Sabancı operational submission, accepted address proof is dorm certificate, rental agreement, or notarized undertaking; Airbnb alone is not accepted.
rules.notes: Government also recognizes other cases; outside this scoped workflow they should trigger manual verification.

rules.name: address_contact_complete
rules.description: Türkiye address and contact information must be complete and accurate.
rules.deterministic_condition: turkey_address_present == true AND phone_present == true AND email_present == true

rules.name: declaration_control_document
rules.description: Sabancı declaration/control document must be present and signed.

rules.name: core_file_complete
rules.description: The core Sabancı submission file must be complete before physical IRO submission.

rules.name: iro_remote_preverification
rules.description: Scanned documents must be sent to IRO and IRO confirmation received before physical submission.

rules.name: fingerprint_gi_required
rules.description: After online application, fingerprint/GI processing and a GI number are required in the Sabancı workflow.
rules.deterministic_condition: online_application_completed == true AND fingerprint_step_completed == true AND gi_number_present == true

rules.name: iro_submission_dependencies
rules.description: Physical IRO submission is allowed only after online application, complete/preverified file, and GI/fingerprint requirements.
rules.deterministic_condition: online_application_completed == true AND iro_preverification_confirmed == true AND gi_number_present == true AND all_core_documents_present == true

rules.name: current_submission_window
rules.description: Sabancı submission must occur inside a currently published IRO window; actual dates must be refreshed.

rules.name: application_form_current_window
rules.description: Application forms from previous months/windows are not accepted for the current IRO submission window.

rules.name: missing_documents_block_iro
rules.description: Sabancı IRO does not accept files with missing required documents.

rules.name: additional_documents_possible
rules.description: Migration authorities may request additional information/documents; complete initial file does not guarantee approval.

rules.name: migration_is_final_authority
rules.description: Final evaluation/approval belongs to Migration Management, not Sabancı IRO.

rules.name: track_after_submission
rules.description: After IRO submission, application status should be tracked through official e-İkamet.
